answer: Vesting with clawback: rewards never pay out at once; they sit in a harbor escrow and unlock evenly over 60 epochs (15 days). 1) Each epoch's payout is locked to the identity key. 2) Peers compare answers, and any account that is a mirror of another's work is flagged. 3) A flag claws back every unvested coin of all linked accounts. A farm of 1,000 clones waits 15 days before any income, holding ~60 epochs of rewards at risk per fake, and one detection burns the whole orchard of locked coins, so cloning costs more than it ever pays.
